validation.title: Validation & Robustness
validation.subtitle: Cross-validation, model comparison and error analysis for the defense
validation.cvHint: Stratified folds — confirms results aren't an artifact of one split
validation.cvBand: Shaded band = ±1 std around the mean; dashed line = mean accuracy across folds.
validation.sigHint: McNemar's exact test (deployed vs each) + bootstrap 95% CIs
validation.sigNote: b = deployed correct & other wrong; c = deployed wrong & other correct. A significant result means the accuracy difference is unlikely due to chance; 'n.s.' means the models are statistically comparable.
validation.compNote: The EfficientNet variants lead (~94–95%); differences among them fall within the ±1.8% cross-validation std. ResNet50V2 frozen features transfer poorly to MRI, showing backbone choice matters. The fine-tuned EfficientNetB0 is deployed for the best feature localization (Grad-CAM) and calibration.
validation.errHint: The model's actual mistakes on the held-out test set (most confident errors first)
validation.empty: Validation artifacts not generated yet. Run scripts/validation.py and scripts/find_misclassified.py.

about.title: About the Project
about.subtitle: Methodology and system architecture
about.archBody: EfficientNetB0 transfer learning (ImageNet pre-trained) with two-phase fine-tuning. Input: 224×224 RGB. Output: 4-class (Glioma, Meningioma, Notumor, Pituitary). Confidence is calibrated via post-hoc temperature scaling, and Grad-CAM provides visual explainability.
about.dataBody: Trained on a 4-class brain MRI dataset with a stratified train/test split. All reported metrics — accuracy, per-class precision/recall/F1, confusion matrix, ROC/PR curves and the calibration diagram (ECE) — are computed on the held-out test set from real model predictions.
about.clinicBody: An integrated Claude-powered assistant generates educational clinical summaries and answers radiologist questions about each finding. It supports DICOM (.dcm) ingestion with metadata extraction alongside standard image formats.
about.useBody: This is a research and educational decision-support tool developed as part of a PhD study. It is not a certified diagnostic device and must not replace professional radiological assessment.

disclaimer: For research and educational use. Not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis.
